errors.text: The proposed silicon intervention does not reconstruct the specific 4.2 at.% Cr addition to HfMoTaTiZr.
No silicon concentration, alloy composition, test temperature, loading mode, or quantitative performance target is specified.
The hypothesis does not address density quantitatively or test preservation of room-temperature strength and ductility.

The cited evidence only states that SiO2 can provide oxidation resistance; it does not show that dilute Si alloying forms a protective scale in the proposed refractory HEA or improves its mechanical performance.
The experiment lacks a prespecified falsifying result and does not distinguish oxidation protection from intrinsic strengthening or microstructural effects.
